name: app.prompt
description: App Studio prompt-library criterion: judge one App Studio prompt (the meta prompt, a stage or role prompt, or a sub-prompt fragment) before it enters capabilities/prompts. Input is the prompt text itself. A library prompt states its contract (id, tier, parent, stage, inputs, output artifact, lessons carried, gates, done_when), binds done to executed evidence, carries lessons as actionable instructions, names its stop rules, and holds outward actions at Gate-D. ADVISORY AND UNCALIBRATED until rig-s1gate calibrate runs on labelled prompts.

contract_stated.instructions: The prompt states its own contract: an id, its tier and parent, the stage it serves, the input variables it expects, and the output artifact it must produce

evidence_done.instructions: The prompt defines done as executed checks recorded with the command, its exit code or status, and the observed output, rather than as a description of intent or of the code

lessons_actionable.instructions: The lessons the prompt carries are imperative instructions a model can act on, each tied to a named lesson id, rather than vague principles

stop_rules.instructions: The prompt says when to stop and report BLOCKED or escalate, and it keeps deploys, pushes, publishing, purchases and paid API spend behind a human approval

leaks_hidden_checks.instructions: The prompt hands the agent under test the verifier's secret acceptance checks or their expected answers, for example a list introduced as the checks the grader will run. The public API contract, the prompt's own done-test and the commands it tells the agent to run for its own evidence are not secret checks and do not count

vague_filler.instructions: The prompt leans on vague filler such as make it good, follow best practices, or be thorough, without a concrete check behind it

readiness.instructions: How safely can an agent run this prompt unattended and produce a verifiable artifact
criteria: Unusable: no contract and no way to verify the output
Partly usable: some contract, but done rests on description
Ready: contract, evidence-bound done, stop rules and gates all explicit

rules.reason: the prompt does not state its contract
done is not bound to executed evidence
hidden acceptance checks leak into the prompt
no stop rule or Gate-D hold
vague filler without a concrete check
